text: erm nevermind. its the fact the t ool is not on a twig (hotreload) so it deselects the mode im on
resolution: Investigated the two hot-reload state issues the user raised: (1) the viewport tool mode (selMode) resetting on hot reload because it is component useState not a hotstate twig, and (2) loop cuts vanishing from the 3D mesh while still showing in the UV panel after a hot reload. Traced the geometry path: the UV reads part.mesh directly while the 3D mesh goes through the host dynamic-geometry slot keyed by dynamicKey 'studio.s<index>~<id>.<version>'; version increments deterministically in the modelStream materializer (partMeshUpdated: prev.version+1) so it is identical after a stream replay, meaning the host keeps stale slot geometry across the reload. The user confirmed it was a hot-reload stale bug and that it is now fixed/fine, so no code change landed from this session for req_1021. The selMode-twig follow-up remains open (deferred 'twig the viewport tool-state' work) if the user wants the mode to survive hot reload.
